title: Non-Linear Returns
equation: Focus Ratio = % of Effort on Your Top 20% Activities
hook: Most of last month's revenue came from stuff you barely touched.
statement: A small slice of effort drives most results.
explainer: Some hours are worth ten others. Grinding low-return hours just adds more.
sop: Rank them by output, not effort.
Work out your Focus Ratio on the top 20%.
equation_example: Only 15% of your time goes to your top 20%. Focus Ratio 15%. Way too low.
question: Write down your top 20%. Block it first.
closing_statement: Do less of what barely matters.
